name: backbrief-kit
description: Run a Claude Code project like a team instead of one long chat. An orchestrator plans the work and routes it to specialist agents, a fresh-context verifier checks finished artifacts before they ship, and project memory carries state across sessions with /handoff and /pickup. Install, then run /backbrief-kit:setup for a guided setup.
